title: Water for Elephants
author: Sara Gruen
summary: A ninety-something man in a care home remembers his youth in the Depression, when he jumped a train and joined a travelling circus as its vet. There he fell for the star performer, married to the volatile ringmaster.
readIf: you like historical romance with plenty of circus-life colour and a frank narrator in old age.
skipIf: you do not want to read scenes of animal cruelty and violence.

pairings.reason: Another novel set among the tents and performers, in a far more magical, dreamy vein.
Also frames a great love story through an old person looking back, with a more sentimental style.
A warm historical American novel with a strong sense of place and a love story at its edges.
